integrity: The claim is the exact group of translations of an individual slice. The Gaussian boundedness criterion, vertical densities, and translation group of the whole boundedness region are credited as prior work.
scientific_limitations: For positive real times and positive incommensurate diagonal rates on a two-coordinate product Gaussian L^p space, with 1<p<infinity and p not two. No classification of commensurate slices, non-diagonal drift, or finite-window discrepancy is asserted.
title: Exact onset of imaginary-time slice periodicity for two-rate Gaussian semigroups
